integrity: The mathematical claim is proved from the published CQR score and quantile definitions and independently replayed by a finite rank-enumeration checker. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the stated noiseless symmetric-band model with continuous fitted widths and the original additive split-CQR calibration; ties and other conformalization variants require separate analysis.
title: Exact empty-set saturation of signed CQR in noiseless variable-width regression
